_about: Frozen copy of src/locales/en/glassDoor.json, for tests only. Tests read this file instead of the live one (jest.config.ts), so editing wording in the live file never breaks a test; copy.test.ts checks the live file against it. Refresh it with `npm run freeze:glassdoor-copy` after adding, renaming or removing a text.

M01.name: Market name and symbol
M01.what: Two fields: the symbol is the page title, the full name sits directly under it.
M01.where: MarketDeployed.symbol and MarketDeployed.name (HooksFactory); also symbol() and name() on the market.

M02.name: Underlying asset
M02.how: Read directly; symbol via the token.

M03.name: Deployed (UTC)
M03.where: Block timestamp of the MarketDeployed log for this market.

M05.name: Market age
M05.what: How long the market has existed.
M05.where: Deployed (UTC) (M03) and the snapshot block timestamp; for closed markets, MarketClosed.timestamp instead of the snapshot.

M06.name: Capacity now
M06.what: The most the market may issue to lenders (deposit cap). Not a borrowing limit.
M06.where: maxTotalSupply() at block N. History: MarketDeployed.maxTotalSupply, then MaxTotalSupplyUpdated.

M07.name: Total owed to lenders now
M07.what: Everything the market owes: lender balances including accrued interest, plus paid-but-unclaimed withdrawals and protocol fees.

M08.name: Assets held by the market
M08.what: Tokens physically sitting in the market contract.

M11.name: Base APR now
M11.what: The interest rate lenders earn right now; lenders receive it in full.

M12.name: Penalty APR
M12.what: Extra rate added to the base APR while the market is Penaltied.
M12.where: delinquencyFeeBips() (fixed at deploy; also in MarketDeployed).

M13.name: Protocol fee share
M13.what: Share of base interest charged to the borrower on top and paid to the protocol. Never deducted from lenders, never charged on the penalty.
M13.how: bips / 100 = % of base interest. Borrower all-in = Base APR now (M11) x (1 + M13 / 100), plus Penalty APR (M12) while Penaltied.
M13.where: currentState().protocolFeeBips; changes via ProtocolFeeBipsUpdated; lifetime amounts = sum of InterestAndFeesAccrued.protocolFees.

M14.name: Reserve ratio
M14.what: Share of outstanding supply the borrower must keep in the market as cash. Applies to supply not queued for exit; temporarily raised after large APR cuts.
M14.where: reserveRatioBips() at block N; history via ReserveRatioBipsUpdated.

M15.name: Grace period (allowed lateness)
M15.what: How long the market may be delinquent before the penalty APR starts.
M15.where: delinquencyGracePeriod() (fixed at deploy; also in MarketDeployed).

M16.name: Withdrawal cycle (payout window)
M16.what: How long a withdrawal batch stays open before it expires. Cycles do not restart on their own.
M16.where: withdrawalBatchDuration() (fixed at deploy; also in MarketDeployed).

M18.name: In order, cash there
M18.what: Share of recorded life when the market held the cash it was required to hold.
M18.how: 100 x (1 - Delinquent seconds (H02) / Recorded life (seconds) (H01)). "never late" when Delinquent seconds (H02) = 0.

M20.name: Delinquency episodes
M20.what: How many separate times the market was short of cash, including an episode still open at block N.
M20.how: Count of finished episodes + open episode (0 or 1). Display "N (1 still open)" when one is open. Averages, buckets and cure rates use finished episodes only.

M21.name: Late within grace now
M21.what: The market is delinquent right now but still inside its grace period.
M21.how: 1 if coverageLiquidity() > totalAssets() and timeDelinquent <= delinquencyGracePeriod, else 0. Do not use currentState().isDelinquent: it is the stored flag and is not recomputed by the view.
M21.where: coverageLiquidity() and totalAssets() at block N; currentState().timeDelinquent; Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15).

M22.name: Mean episode duration
M22.what: Average length of a finished episode.
M22.how: Sum of closed durations / number of closed episodes.

M23.name: Longest episode
M23.what: Length of the single longest episode; an open episode counts at its running length.

M24.name: Worst incident, share of allowance
M24.what: How much of the grace period the worst episode used; over 100 = the allowance was exceeded.
M24.how: 100 x Longest episode (M23) / Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15).

M25.name: Grace breaches
M25.what: How many times the penalty actually started.
M25.how: Count penalty spans. The clock does not reset between episodes and the penalty continues after cash is restored until timeDelinquent drops below grace, so spans and episodes do not line up one to one.
M25.where: InterestAndFeesAccrued logs: a breach is a continuous run of logs with delinquencyFeeRay > 0 (a penalty span).

M26.name: Time under penalty
M26.what: Share of life when the penalty APR was charging.
M26.how: Penalty seconds per log = delinquencyFeeRay x 31,536,000 / (delinquencyFeeBips x 10^23). M26 = 100 x (sum of penalty seconds from the logs + Penalty seconds in the quiet window (H09)) / Recorded life (seconds) (H01). Do not count whole intervals: a log can be partly penalised.
M26.where: InterestAndFeesAccrued logs: delinquencyFeeRay > 0 means the penalty was charging over part of the interval; plus the projected penalty seconds of the quiet window (Penalty seconds in the quiet window (H09)).

M27.name: Penalty interest paid
M27.what: Total extra interest lenders earned from the penalty.
M27.how: Per log: scaledTotalSupply x prevScaleFactor x delinquencyFeeRay / 10^54. Sum / 10^decimals.
M27.where: InterestAndFeesAccrued.delinquencyFeeRay per log, applied to the supply at that time.

M30.name: Batches expired
M30.what: How many exit batches reached their deadline.
M30.where: Count of WithdrawalBatchExpired logs up to block N.

M31.name: Batches fully funded at expiry
M31.what: Batches that had all their money ready on the deadline.
M31.how: Count logs where scaledAmountBurned = scaledTotalAmount (scaled with scaled). The contract processes the batch at the next transaction after expiry with the cash held then, so a repayment after the deadline but before the next touch still counts as on time.

M32.name: Exits paid on time
M32.what: Share of exit deadlines met in full on the day.
M32.how: 100 x Batches fully funded at expiry (M31) / Batches expired (M30). Blank when Batches expired (M30) = 0. STRONG only with Batches expired (M30) >= 10, else LIMITED.
M32.where: Batches fully funded at expiry (M31), Batches expired (M30).

M33.name: Exits paid on time, by money
M33.what: Share of requested exit value that was available on the day.
M33.how: 100 x sum(paid at expiry) / sum(requested, normalized at expiry).
M33.where: WithdrawalBatchExpired: normalizedAmountPaid and scaledTotalAmount x scaleFactor at expiry.

M37.name: Open unpaid batches now
M37.what: Exit batches that expired and are still not fully paid.

M38.name: Unclaimed withdrawals
M38.what: Money already paid into expired batches, waiting for lenders to claim; reserved, cannot be borrowed.

M39.name: Realised lender APR
M39.what: The rate lenders actually earned over the market's life, weighted by money and time; includes penalty interest.
M39.how: Interest per log = scaledTotalSupply x prevScaleFactor x (baseInterestRay + delinquencyFeeRay) / 10^54, where prevScaleFactor = scaleFactor / (1 + (baseInterestRay + delinquencyFeeRay) / 10^27). Realised APR = sum(interest) / sum(normalized supply x seconds) x 31,536,000.
M39.where: InterestAndFeesAccrued logs and the scaled supply before each log (previousState() or rebuilt from events).

M40.name: Time-weighted base APR
M40.what: Average posted rate over the market's life.
M40.how: Sum(rate x seconds in force) / Recorded life (seconds) (H01).
M40.where: MarketDeployed.annualInterestBips, then every AnnualInterestBipsUpdated with its timestamp.

M41.name: Lifetime lender interest
M41.what: All interest lenders earned, base plus penalty.
M41.where: InterestAndFeesAccrued logs, per-log interest as in Realised lender APR (M39).

M42.name: Penalty share of lender interest
M42.what: How much of all interest came from the penalty.
M42.how: 100 x Penalty interest paid (M27) / Lifetime lender interest (M41). This is the locked definition (closes v3 open item C5).
M42.where: Penalty interest paid (M27), Lifetime lender interest (M41).

M44.name: APR changes
M44.what: How many times the rate was changed.

M48.name: Active lenders now
M48.what: Wallets holding market tokens right now.
M48.how: Count addresses with scaledBalanceOf > 0. Exclude the market contract itself (it holds tokens queued for withdrawal), 0x0 and escrow addresses.
M48.where: Addresses from Transfer logs; scaledBalanceOf(address) at block N.

M49.name: Distinct lenders, lifetime
M49.what: Every wallet that ever held this market's token.
M49.how: Count unique addresses. Transfer values are normalized: never sum them for balances.
M49.where: Transfer logs: every to-address other than 0x0, the market and escrows.

M51.name: Lender retention
M51.what: Share of all past lenders who still hold tokens.
M51.how: 100 x Active lenders now (M48) / Distinct lenders, lifetime (M49).
M51.where: Active lenders now (M48), Distinct lenders, lifetime (M49).

M57.name: Lifetime repaid
M57.what: Everything the borrower repaid through the repay functions.
M57.how: Sum / 10^decimals. Undercounts plain ERC-20 transfer repayments: reconcile with totalAssets() jumps.

M58.name: Out with the borrower
M58.how: Card shows event basis: Lifetime borrowed (M56) - Lifetime repaid (M57) (principal only). State basis = Total owed to lenders now (M07) - Assets held by the market (M08) includes accrued interest and is a different number; label whichever is shown.
M58.where: Lifetime borrowed (M56), Lifetime repaid (M57) (event basis); totalDebts() - totalAssets() (state basis).

M59.name: Borrow transactions
M59.what: How many times the borrower drew money.

M60.name: Repay transactions
M60.what: How many times the borrower repaid.

M67.name: In order, trailing 90 days
M67.what: The cash-there grade restricted to the last 90 days.
M67.how: 100 x (1 - delinquent seconds in window / recorded seconds in window). Blank when the window holds fewer than 7 days of records.
M67.where: Recorded life (seconds) (H01) and Delinquent seconds (H02) restricted to accrual intervals and episode time inside (block N timestamp - 90 days, block N], tail included.

M68.name: Trend
M68.what: Whether the last 90 days are better or worse than the whole life.
M68.how: In order, trailing 90 days (M67) - In order, cash there (M18). Blank when In order, trailing 90 days (M67) is blank.
M68.where: In order, trailing 90 days (M67), In order, cash there (M18).

M71.name: Episodes 24 to 48 hours
M71.what: Long episodes still inside a 48 h grace.

M77.name: Lifecycle status
M77.how: Open if false, Closed (shown as "Finished") if true.
M77.where: isClosed() at block N; closure time from MarketClosed(timestamp).

M80.name: Quiet window (hours)
M80.what: How long the market has had no recorded activity, for the stale-record warning on the grade card. The same quantity as Hours since last activity (M82); kept as its own id because it drives the warning line on the grade card.
M80.how: (block N timestamp - lastInterestAccruedTimestamp) / 3,600, identical to Hours since last activity (M82). Show the warning line ("record silent N h") when above 24 h while the market owes money.

M82.name: Hours since last activity
M82.what: How stale the chain record is at block N.

M83.name: Cured within grace
M83.what: Share of finished episodes that ended before the penalty started.
M83.how: 100 x closed episodes containing no penalty span / closed episodes.
M83.where: Closed episodes from Delinquent seconds (H02) and the penalty spans (Grace breaches (M25)).

M84.name: Days since last episode cured
M84.what: How long the market has been in order since the last episode ended.
M84.how: (block N timestamp - last episode end) / 86,400. "never late" if no episode ever; hidden while an episode is open.
M84.where: End time of the latest closed episode in Delinquent seconds (H02).

M85.name: Past grace now
M85.what: The market is past its grace period right now.
M85.how: 1 if timeDelinquent > delinquencyGracePeriod, else 0. Can be 1 while the market already holds enough cash (the penalty outlasts the shortfall).
M85.where: currentState().timeDelinquent at block N; Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15).

M86.name: Capacity used
M86.what: How full the deposit cap is.
M86.how: 100 x totalSupply() / maxTotalSupply(). The cap limits totalSupply (lender balances), not totalDebts. Can exceed 100 through interest. Blank when closed.
M86.where: totalSupply() and maxTotalSupply() at block N.

S01.name: Markets on Wildcat
S01.what: How many markets this borrower runs or ran.
S01.how: Count markets that ever took deposits; never-funded markets are counted separately, not graded.
S01.where: MarketAdded logs on the ArchController for the list; borrower() on each market to group.

S02.name: First market deployed
S02.what: When the borrower started on Wildcat.
S02.where: MarketDeployed timestamps of the borrower's markets.

S05.name: In order, all markets
S05.what: The cash-there grade across all the borrower's markets, weighted by age.
S05.how: Sum(In order, cash there (M18) x Market age (M05)) / sum(Market age (M05)).
S05.where: In order, cash there (M18) and Market age (M05) of each funded market.

S06.name: Worst market
S06.what: The weakest market in the book.
S06.where: In order, cash there (M18) of each market.

S07.name: Best market
S07.what: The strongest market in the book.
S07.how: Max In order, cash there (M18); header shows spread = S07 - Worst market (S06) for multi-market borrowers.
S07.where: In order, cash there (M18) of each market.

S12.name: Episodes, all markets
S12.what: All episodes across the borrower's markets, including any still open.
S12.how: Sum Delinquency episodes (M20). Display "N (K still open)" when any are open.

S13.name: Grace breaches, all markets
S13.what: All penalty spans across the book.
S13.how: Sum Grace breaches (M25); per market = S13 / Markets on Wildcat (S01); per 100 episodes = 100 x S13 / Episodes, all markets (S12).

S14.name: Batches expired, all markets
S14.what: Exit deadlines faced across the book.

S15.name: Batches funded at expiry, all markets
S15.what: Deadlines met in full across the book.
S15.how: Sum Batches fully funded at expiry (M31).
S15.where: Batches fully funded at expiry (M31) of each market.

S16.name: Exits paid on time, all markets
S16.what: Share of all exit deadlines met in full, whole book.
S16.how: 100 x Batches funded at expiry, all markets (S15) / Batches expired, all markets (S14). Blank when Batches expired, all markets (S14) = 0; STRONG only with Batches expired, all markets (S14) >= 10.
S16.where: Batches funded at expiry, all markets (S15), Batches expired, all markets (S14).

S17.name: Weakest market on exits
S17.what: Lowest M32 in the book, shown with that market's own M30.
S17.where: Exits paid on time (M32) and Batches expired (M30) of each market.

S18.name: Markets late now
S18.what: How many of the borrower's markets are delinquent right now.
S18.how: Count markets with Late within grace now (M21) = 1 or Past grace now (M85) = 1.
S18.where: Late within grace now (M21) and Past grace now (M85) of each market.

S27.name: In order, all markets, trailing 90 days
S27.what: The book grade restricted to the last 90 days.
S27.how: Sum(In order, trailing 90 days (M67) x window days) / sum(window days).
S27.where: In order, trailing 90 days (M67) and the window-days of each market.

S28.name: Trend, all markets
S28.what: Whether the book is getting better or worse.
S28.how: In order, all markets, trailing 90 days (S27) - In order, all markets (S05).
S28.where: In order, all markets, trailing 90 days (S27), In order, all markets (S05).

S30.name: Completed facilities
S30.what: Markets this borrower closed after repaying everything.
S30.how: Count closed markets that ever took deposits. "none completed yet" when 0.
S30.where: MarketClosed logs on the borrower's markets.

S31.name: Capital through completed facilities
S31.what: Deposits that went through the markets the borrower closed.
S31.how: Sum of assetAmount over completed markets / 10^decimals. Leads the card; the count is fine print.
S31.where: Deposit logs of the completed markets.

S32.name: Share of record from completed facilities
S32.what: How much of the borrower's history comes from finished loans.
S32.how: 100 x sum Market age (M05) (completed) / sum Market age (M05) (all).
S32.where: Market age (M05) of completed markets and of all markets.

S33.name: Completions verified
S33.what: Whether each closure covered everything owed exactly; stored once, never recomputed in the UI. (New definition: v3 used S33 for the protocol-wide count, which is an anchor, not a metric.)
S33.how: Count completed markets passing the check; card renders "verified" only from the stored result.
S33.where: State at the MarketClosed block: totalAssets() >= totalDebts() and the market not delinquent.

S34.name: Clean closures
S34.what: Completions with no delinquency episode open at the moment of closing.
S34.how: Count completed markets with no open episode at close.
S34.where: Delinquent seconds (H02) episodes of the completed markets and MarketClosed.timestamp.

S35.name: Debt late within grace now
S35.what: Owed amount in the borrower's markets that are late but still inside grace.
S35.how: Sum Total owed to lenders now (M07). Whole-market debt, labelled as such.
S35.where: Total owed to lenders now (M07) of each market with Late within grace now (M21) = 1.

S36.name: Debt past grace now
S36.what: Owed amount in the borrower's markets that are past grace.
S36.how: Sum Total owed to lenders now (M07). Whole-market debt, not the shortfall; label it.
S36.where: Total owed to lenders now (M07) of each market with Past grace now (M85) = 1.

S37.name: Distinct lenders, all markets
S37.what: Different wallets that ever lent to this borrower.
S37.how: Count unique addresses that ever held a market token of the borrower, with the same exclusions as Distinct lenders, lifetime (M49). Includes former lenders and positions received by transfer; depositors only would be a different, smaller number.
S37.where: Transfer logs (to not 0x0, the market or an escrow) across the borrower's markets.

D03.name: Minimum deposit
D03.what: Smallest deposit the market accepts; borrower can change it after launch.
D03.where: Hooks instance configuration (minimumDeposit on the hooks template).

D05.name: Grace countdown
D05.what: Time left before the penalty starts, shown while the market is late.
D05.how: Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15) - timeDelinquent, floored at 0; past 0 show time past grace. The clock winds down after a cure, so the countdown may start above zero.
D05.where: Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15) and currentState().timeDelinquent at block N.

D06.name: Cycle status
D06.what: Whether a payout cycle is running and when it ends.
D06.how: If pendingWithdrawalExpiry > block N timestamp: "current cycle ends in (expiry - now)". Else: "next cycle starts with the next withdrawal request". Never a standing countdown.

D10.name: Current lender concentration
D10.what: Share held by the biggest single lender and the top three, from current balances.
D10.how: 100 x max scaledBalanceOf / scaledTotalSupply; top three summed. Current balances, not lifetime deposits (closes v3 item C6). Label "by design" on allowlisted markets.
D10.where: scaledBalanceOf(address) at block N for every holder; scaledTotalSupply from currentState().

D11.name: Defaults on record
D11.what: Declared defaults, from app KYB data.
D11.how: Display only; never enters a grade.

D15.name: Longest episode, all markets
D15.what: Worst single episode across the borrower's markets.
D15.how: Max Longest episode (M23), shown in hours against that market's Grace period (allowed lateness) (M15). A longest episode, not a rate (closes the v3 D15 question).

D16.name: Typical cure time, all markets
D16.what: Typical length of a finished episode across the book.
D16.how: Sum of finished durations / number of finished episodes.
D16.where: Finished episodes (Delinquent seconds (H02)) of every market; the open episode is excluded because it has no final length.

D17.name: Late time per market
D17.what: Cumulative delinquent days per market, tooltip of the trouble chart.

D18.name: Uncovered deadlines: paid late / never paid
D18.what: Splits the batches that missed their deadline.
D18.how: Short at expiry, then: Closed in a later transaction = paid late; expiry still in getUnpaidBatchExpiries() at N = never paid at snapshot. A batch fully paid at expiry emits Expired and Closed in the same transaction: not late. Computable from logs (v3 finding): "split coming soon" only until this is built.
D18.where: WithdrawalBatchExpired (short at expiry: scaledAmountBurned < scaledTotalAmount), WithdrawalBatchClosed(expiry) in a later transaction, getUnpaidBatchExpiries() at N.

D21.name: Contract kept, all markets
D21.what: The contract-kept grade across the book, same weighting. (New id: cheat sheet v3 used S28 for this, which collides with S28 trend.)
D21.how: 100 - sum(Time under penalty (M26) x Market age (M05)) / sum(Market age (M05)).
D21.where: Time under penalty (M26) and Market age (M05) of each funded market.

H01.name: Recorded life (seconds)
H01.what: The whole life of the market up to block N, quiet window included.
H01.how: End timestamp - deploy timestamp. The quiet window is always part of recorded life, whether or not the market was short during it.
H01.where: MarketDeployed block timestamp (Deployed (UTC) (M03)) and the timestamp of block N; for closed markets, MarketClosed.timestamp instead of block N.

H02.name: Delinquent seconds
H02.what: Total time the market was short of required cash, plus the silent tail.
H02.how: Sum of episode durations from the logs + Silent tail: short time inside the quiet window (seconds) (H08) (the short part of the quiet window). The flag is rewritten only when a transaction touches the market, so an onset caused by a batch expiring is recorded at the next touch.
H02.where: StateUpdated logs walked in order: false to true opens an episode at that block's timestamp, true to false closes it; open at N ends at N. Plus Silent tail: short time inside the quiet window (seconds) (H08).

H08.name: Silent tail: short time inside the quiet window (seconds)
H08.what: The part of the quiet window (last accrual to block N) during which the market was actually short of cash. Counts as delinquent time.
H08.how: Quiet window = lastInterestAccruedTimestamp to block N timestamp. The market is short when coverageLiquidity() > totalAssets(). Inside the window the required cash only rises (interest and fees accrue) and the held cash only rises through direct transfers in, so split the window at each direct transfer; in each piece, if the market is not short at its end it was not short anywhere in it, otherwise find the moment it became short. H08 = total short seconds. 0 for closed markets.
H08.where: currentState().lastInterestAccruedTimestamp; coverageLiquidity() and totalAssets() evaluated inside the quiet window; Transfer logs of the asset token into the market address (direct transfers).

H09.name: Penalty seconds in the quiet window
H09.what: Penalty time inside the quiet window, as the contract itself accounts for it.
H09.how: Apply the Time under penalty (M26) per-log formula to the projected interval: delinquencyFeeRay of the projection x 31,536,000 / (delinquencyFeeBips x 10^23). Follows the contract's own record (the stored delinquency flag), so a market that went short silently shows no penalty here until the next transaction updates its state.
H09.where: currentState() at block N, which projects interest and the grace clock from the last accrual to block N.

G4.name: Market type labels
G4.what: Fixed or open term (and maturity), deposit access model (self-onboarding or borrower allowlist), token transferability (open, restricted, disabled), MLA signed.
G4.how: Lookup, no arithmetic. Show deposit access and token transfers as two separate badges.
G4.where: MarketDeployed.hooks and the hooks instance or template; MLA from app data.

card_2_1.name: In order
card_2_1.means: Of all the time this market existed, the share when the required cash was there. Second line: the share it never went past the allowed lateness.
card_2_1.tells: [lender] How reliably the exit cash was in place. [borrower] Whether the operating style is just-in-time funding (gap between the two lines) or rule-breaking (low second line).
card_2_1.notTells: Whether anyone lost money, or whether exits were paid (card 2.3). Nothing about the present (card 2.4).

compare.cashAndKept: protocol medians: cash there {{cash}} · contract kept {{kept}}

formula.trendShortWindow: under 7 days recorded in the last 90 days
formula.trendClosed: none after closure: the last 90 days hold no recorded time

chart.lenses: {{days}} recorded days · line 1 = green segment (M18) · line 2 = everything but red = 100 − M26

chips.position: their {{n}} markets: {{low}} to {{high}}; this market is the {{place}}
chips.gradedRange: their {{n}} graded markets: {{low}} to {{high}}; this market has no grade yet

card_2_2.name: Worst incident
card_2_2.means: How close to the edge it ever got, measured against this market’s own allowed lateness. Over 100 means a deadline broke at least once.
card_2_2.tells: [lender] Whether the rule was ever broken and how often. [borrower] The single worst day on record.
card_2_2.notTells: Whether it happened once or often (card 2.8). Nothing about exits (card 2.3) or the present (card 2.4).

sub.noGrace: no grace period to measure against
sub.noPenalty: of the allowed lateness · counted on the record; no penalty charged on chain

formula.noIncident: No delinquency episode has been recorded: $t(metrics.M23.name) (M23) = 0 h.
formula.noGrace: Grace period (M15) is 0 h, so a share of the allowance is undefined.

chips.median: median worst incident {{median}} of allowance · {{population}} graded markets
chips.bookThis: their book: longest episode {{longest}}, this market

card_2_3.name: Exits paid on time
card_2_3.means: When lenders asked for money back, was the full amount there on the deadline, by count and by money, and where does the owed money sit.
card_2_3.tells: [lender] The exit record and whether the queue is clear today. [borrower] How often repayment flow arrived in time.
card_2_3.notTells: The wait within the day, and never the future. Not covered on the day is not never paid; the split is coming (D18).

formula.none: $t(metrics.M30.name) (M30) = 0: no withdrawal batch has reached its deadline.
formula.notCoveredSplit: not covered = {{missed}} → paid late {{late}} / never paid {{never}} (D18)
formula.notCovered: not covered = {{missed}} → paid late / never paid: {{blank}} (D18)

chart.marksSplit: {{covered}} dark = fully funded on the deadline (M31) · {{late}} hatched = paid late, {{never}} red = never paid (D18)
chart.marks: {{covered}} dark = fully funded on the deadline (M31) · {{missed}} hatched = not covered on the day

chips.median: median market: {{median}} of deadlines funded on the day · {{population}} graded markets

card_2_4.name: Right now
card_2_4.means: Is the required cash there this second, and if not, how much of the allowed lateness remains.
card_2_4.tells: [lender] Whether to act today. [borrower] The live countdown.
